name: Breadcrumb
description: A hierarchical trail with router-ready items and automatic middle-item collapse.
usage:
<Breadcrumb
  items={[
    { label: 'Workspace', href: '/' },
    { label: 'Projects', href: '/projects' },
    { label: 'Orion' },
  ]}
/>

anatomy.description: Nav landmark rendering the items in order as links.
Chevron icons between items, hidden from assistive technology.
The last item, rendered as text with aria-current="page".
Middle items fold into an overflow menu past collapseAfter.

dos: Keep the last item as plain text; it is the current page, not a link.
Prefer collapsing middle items over truncating labels on narrow screens.
donts: Don't use breadcrumbs on flat structures or as a back button.
Don't duplicate the primary navigation in the trail.

examples.title: Hierarchy
examples.description: Items render in order; the last item is the current page.

examples.title: Collapsed middle items
examples.description: Trails longer than collapseAfter move middle items into a labeled menu.

guidance.useWhen: Users need to see and move within a deep page hierarchy.
guidance.avoidWhen: The structure is flat or the trail would duplicate primary navigation.
guidance.behavior: The last item is the current page; middle items collapse into a menu past collapseAfter.
guidance.responsive: Let items wrap and prefer collapsing over shrinking labels.

keyboard.action: Moves focus through the trail links and the collapsed-items menu trigger.

notes: Renders a nav landmark with an ordered list; the landmark label defaults to "Breadcrumb".
The current page is a span with aria-current="page", not a link.
Middle items beyond collapseAfter move into a labeled menu.
Pass a router link component through an item's as prop, mirroring VerticalNavItem.

props.description: Maximum items shown before middle items collapse into a menu.
props.name: collapseAfter

props.description: Items in hierarchy order; the last item is the current page.
props.name: items

props.description: Accessible name for the navigation landmark.
props.name: label
